title: Stacking Button Puzzle
description: Location: In the middle of the starting field near the cliff Solution: Stack up your friend to reach the button on the crane Reward: Red Blob

title: Timing Button Puzzle
description: Location: On top of a hill over the valley Solution: Click every button on the green structure at the same time Reward: Red Blob

title: Matching Tiles Puzzle
description: Location: At the top of the hill over the valley Solution: Match the tiles on the pegboard outside with what can be seen inside the room Reward: Red Blob

title: Locked Box Puzzle
description: Location: On top of the cliff looking over the valley Solution: Have one person sit and press the button, opening the box across the valley, while another heads to the box - [Locked Box](https://mapgenie.io/big-walk/maps/island?locationIds=930216) Reward: Red Blob

title: Maze Puzzle
description: Location: Down the mountain on the beach Solution: Grab the timer and hand off the timer through the holes to your friends to place it on the pedestal Reward: Red Blob

title: Point and Click Puzzle
description: Location: On the side of a mountain Solution: Press the buttons in the correct sequence copying the lights from the inside without being able to communicate Reward: Red Blob

title: Cannon Puzzle
description: Location: On the rocks next to the [Train Station](https://mapgenie.io/big-walk/maps/island?locationIds=930175) Solution: Activate the timer to shoot it out of the cannon, then have a friend grab it and throw it back and place it into the pedestal Reward: Red Blob

title: Basketball Puzzle
description: Location: Next to the stream in the open Solution: Throw the light through the hoop until the bar fills up Reward: Red Blob

title: Memory Puzzle
description: Location: On a ledge of a cliff Solution: Open up only the orbs that have the green blobs in them to activate the pillar Reward: Red Blob

title: Pose Puzzle
description: Location: On top of the cliff looking over the valley Solution: Have a friend head to each of the points with the red ledges and match the poses on the cards, then place the cards with the correct pose into each of the slots - [Pose Picture](https://mapgenie.io/big-walk/maps/island?locationIds=930217) - [Pose Picture](https://mapgenie.io/big-walk/maps/island?locationIds=930218) - [Pose Picture](https://mapgenie.io/big-walk/maps/island?locationIds=930219) - [Pose Picture](https://mapgenie.io/big-walk/maps/island?locationIds=930220) - [Pose Picture](https://mapgenie.io/big-walk/maps/island?locationIds=930221) Reward: Red Blob

title: Counting Lights Puzzle
description: Location: Near the train tracks in the open Solution: Count how many of the lights change after clicking the button for the period of time they change, then input that amount into the counter on the wall Reward: Red Blob

title: Locked Up Puzzle
description: Location: In the middle of the brush Solution: Press both buttons on the walls to unlock the red blob, then hit the secret button and give the correct order for the symbols on the wall to escape Reward: Red Blob

title: Far Away Lights Puzzle
description: Location: On the beach in two separate buildings - [Far Away Lights Puzzle Second Building](https://mapgenie.io/big-walk/maps/island?locationIds=930215) Solution: Have at least one friend in each building and count the lights on the wall. Relay that information to the other building to increment the counter. Reward: Red Blob

title: Double Press Puzzle
description: Location: On a ledge up the mountain Solution: Press the switch the same time as a friend pushes the switch on the rocks near the beach - [Second Switch](https://mapgenie.io/big-walk/maps/island?locationIds=930223) Reward: Red Blob

title: Clifftop Golf Puzzle
description: Location: On the edge of the cliff Solution: Carry the ball from the starting point and place it into the hole - [Golf Tee](https://mapgenie.io/big-walk/maps/island?locationIds=930296) Reward: Purple Blob

title: Warehouse Puzzle
description: Location: On a ledge between the water and the middle of the mountains Solution: Head through both doors, close them, and head through the turnstiles, then communicate the order of the icons from one player to the other Reward: Purple Blob

title: Beach House Icon Puzzle
description: Location: On a ledge over the shore Solution: Head through both turnstiles, then communicate the order of the icons from one player to the other on the back porch Reward: Purple Blob

title: Greenhouse Puzzle
description: Location: On a ledge between the beach and the middle of the mountains Solution: Have a friend go into the side room and communicate which sounds match the speaker in the sound room and slot them into the right hole Reward: Purple Blob

title: Beach Timer Puzzle
description: Location: On top of some scaffolding over the water on the beach Solution: Using your friends, carry one over the different obstacles to open the doors, requiring clicking switches at the same time and maneuvering over a large staircase, to bring the timer to the pedestal at the end Reward: Purple Blob

title: Multi-Light Puzzle
description: Location: Split between two buildings on a ledge over the water - [Multi-Light Puzzle Second Building](https://mapgenie.io/big-walk/maps/island?locationIds=930259) Solution: Head into both buildings and, using the intercom and the red light, communicate which lights to click in sequence Reward: Purple Blob

title: Patience Puzzle
description: Location: On top of the cliff overlooking the water Solution: Sit there for 30 minutes with a friend and enjoy their company :) Reward: Purple Blob

title: Ravine Golf Puzzle
description: Location: At the bottom of the cliff at the end of the ravine Solution: Carry the ball from the starting point and place it into the hole - [Golf Tee](https://mapgenie.io/big-walk/maps/island?locationIds=930296) Reward: Red Blob

title: Passing Puzzle
description: Location: On top of a ledge up the cliff Solution: Have a friend head across to the opposite side and communicate which pieces need to be passed across to fill in the symbols Reward: Red Blob

title: Interrogation Puzzle
description: Location: In the side of the cliff Solution: Using the one-way glass and the red light, relay the information between players on which symbols need to go to which spot Reward: Red Blob

title: Climbing Puzzle
description: Location: On top of the cliff embedded into the ground Solution: Start at the bottom and keep kicking the block with the blob in it up onto the platforms. Slowly but surely keep doing it until it reaches the top, then place it on the pedestal Reward: Red Blob

title: Stage Puzzle
description: Location: Embedded in the cliff wall Solution: Have a friend head into the upper stage area and communicate which buttons need to be clicked by which ones are lit up Reward: Red Blob

title: 50/50 Puzzle
description: Location: In a building raised over the forest Solution: Using the red light and the speaker, communicate between each other the rest of the symbols to complete both sides Reward: Red Blob

title: Headless Chicken Puzzle
description: Location: On the side of the hill near the coast Solution: Have a friend put on the mask and head into the area through the turnstile, then navigate your blind friend to match the symbols in pairs Reward: Red Blob

title: Tower Puzzle
description: Location: On the beach next to the water Solution: Hit both of the nearby switches at the same time - [Tower Switch](https://mapgenie.io/big-walk/maps/island?locationIds=930326) - [Tower Switch](https://mapgenie.io/big-walk/maps/island?locationIds=930327) Reward: Red Blob

title: Forget-Me-Not Puzzle
description: Location: In the middle of a peninsula embedded into the ground Solution: Head to previous puzzles with the corresponding icons and sounds and place the icon/sound on the corresponding slot Reward: Red Blob

title: Brown Tower Puzzle
description: Location: In the middle of the forest Solution: Have a friend head to and push the hidden button to open the box - [Brown Tower Button](https://mapgenie.io/big-walk/maps/island?locationIds=930343) Reward: Red Blob

title: Invisible Ink Puzzle
description: Location: In the middle of the forest on a hill Solution: Using the telescope, look at each blank sign to read their symbols. Memorize their symbols then head out of the room and close the door to figure out the order to place them Reward: Red Blob

title: Hanging Timer Puzzle
description: Location: On top of some scaffolding off the side of the cliff Solution: Using your friends, carry one over the different obstacles to open the doors, requiring clicking switches at the same time and maneuvering over a large staircase, to bring the timer past the last door to the pedestal at the end Reward: Red Blob

title: Camouflage Puzzle
description: Location: Embedded in the rocks on the beach Solution: Hold the button down on the green obstacle down the beach to open the box - [Camouflage Box Button](https://mapgenie.io/big-walk/maps/island?locationIds=930333) Reward: Red Blob

title: Little Patience Puzzle
description: Location: On top of a ledge over the water Solution: Sit there for 5 minutes with a friend and enjoy their company :) Reward: Red Blob

title: Super Camouflage Box Puzzle
description: Location: Hidden on top of the large rock near the stream Solution: Hit this switch at the same time as a friend hits the switch down the stream - [Super Camouflage Box Switch](https://mapgenie.io/big-walk/maps/island?locationIds=930341) Reward: Red Bolb

title: Mountain Icon Puzzle
description: Location: On top of the mountain overlooking the cliff Solution: Head through both turnstiles, then communicate the order of the icons from one player to the other on the back porch Reward: Red Blob

title: Mask Maze Puzzle
description: Location: On top of some scaffolding hanging over the stream Solution: Have a friend put on the mask and guide them through the obstacle course without them falling off to the button at the end Reward: Red Bulb

title: Large Warehouse Puzzle
description: Location: Between two parts of a stream in the open Solution: Head into both sides of the warehouse and communicate the order of the symbols using different poses Reward: Red Blob

title: Playground Puzzle
description: Location: Embedded in the ground Solution: Head into each section of the puzzle and set up the kettles to be in the places where it would communicate to the other person where the dots should be, then allow the other person to head in then set up the symbols on the wall correctly Reward: Red Blob

title: Double Cliff Puzzle
description: Location: On top of the cliff over the train tracks Solution: Head into each of the different buildings and communicate over the valley which lights need to be pressed - [Double Cliff Puzzle Second Building](https://mapgenie.io/big-walk/maps/island?locationIds=930356) Reward: Red Blob

title: Musical Speaker Puzzle
description: Location: In the open on top of a hill Solution: Have a friend go into the side room and communicate which sounds match the speaker in the sound room and slot them into the right hole Reward: Red Blob

title: Hide and Seek Puzzle
description: Location: On top of the cliff overlooking the valley Solution: Look around the area and find all 9 yellow dots, 9 red dots, 9 green dots, and 9 blue dots, corresponding to different parts of the scenery, then place them all on the board Reward: Red Blob

title: Musical Chair Puzzle
description: Location: On a ledge overlooking the valley Solution: Have someone sit in the chair and speak into each microphone. The correct microphone will hear clearly for the person in the chair, while the other ones will be one-sided Reward: Red Blob

title: Musical Camouflage Box Puzzle
description: Location: Surrounded by large rocks near the speaker area Solution: Have a friend head to the listening station over the water and have them listen to the song and press the button to open the box - [Musical Camouflage Box Button](https://mapgenie.io/big-walk/maps/island?locationIds=930337) Reward: Red Blob
